module.section_title: Room Signage & Door Display Project References
module.section_subtitle: Reference formats for hotel room identification, doorbell, service status, and guest-facing display planning.
module.intro_text: Review representative hospitality room-signage formats across dark glass, brushed silver, and brushed aluminum finishes. These images illustrate project-style layouts and visible interface treatments for discussion; they are not standard stocked SKUs or customer endorsements.

display_groups.title: 86-Base Wide Display References
display_groups.description: Long-format room-number, doorbell, and service-status layout references.

display_groups.title: Brushed Silver Doorplate References
display_groups.description: Recessed room-number and status-display layouts with a brushed silver finish.

display_groups.title: Dark Glass Room Status Display References
display_groups.description: Guest-service, room-status, and doorbell interface references on a dark glass face.

display_groups.title: Brushed Aluminum Doorplate References
display_groups.description: Wide brushed-metal doorplate layouts for room identification and service controls.

cta_primary.label: Discuss Your Hotel Room Display Requirements

module.disclaimer_text: Images are presented as hotel room signage and door display project references. Any visible brand names, room numbers, or interface content appear only to illustrate application context and configuration format and do not indicate endorsement, authorization, or a customer relationship. Actual appearance, text, icons, functions, material, dimensions, connectivity, MOQ, lead time, compatibility, and production scope are subject to project review and written confirmation. Displayed configurations are not representations of standard in-stock SKUs.
risk_notes: Do not use any selected brand image as the page hero.
Do not name visible brands or room numbers in headings, captions, filenames, ALT text, metadata, or schema.
Do not link image cards to product pages or describe them as purchasable SKUs.
Keep the Project display reference label and full disclaimer visible.

seo_schema_assessment.item: Existing Solution page metadata and canonical
seo_schema_assessment.reason: Retain the current Hotel Guest Room Control Solution metadata unchanged.
The display module is supporting content inside an existing Solution page.
seo_schema_assessment.risk: Do not add branded project claims to structured data.

seo_schema_assessment.reason: The images are project display references, not products or SKUs.
seo_schema_assessment.risk: Would incorrectly classify the references as products.

seo_schema_assessment.reason: No public price or inventory state is provided.
seo_schema_assessment.risk: Unsupported commercial data would be misleading.

seo_schema_assessment.reason: Visible brands do not represent reviews, endorsements, or customer testimonials.
seo_schema_assessment.risk: Could imply an unsupported customer relationship.

seo_schema_assessment.reason: There is no authorized project narrative or new Case Study page.
seo_schema_assessment.risk: Could overstate the provenance of the images.

seo_schema_assessment.reason: The module should enhance an existing Solution URL only.
seo_schema_assessment.risk: A new gallery URL would create unnecessary scope and thin-content risk.

risk_assessment.handling: Keep brands inside source imagery only; omit them from public filenames, ALT text, headings, metadata, and promotional claims; show the disclaimer.
Use them only as visual application context and do not repeat the specific numbers in copy or metadata.
Do not describe any visible brand as a customer, partner, case study, or endorsement; keep the explicit no-endorsement disclaimer.
Use Project display reference labels, no product links, no product cards, and clear project-confirmation language.
Exclude rear construction and electrical-label images and publish no dimensions, material claims, protocols, or compatibility specifications.
Use eight selected images and retain ten artifact-heavy, rear, or near-duplicate images internally.
Place the module only on the Hotel Guest Room Control Solution page and do not create product routes or taxonomy entries.
Treat the card label and full disclaimer as mandatory module content.
The selected eight images are suitable when the module remains project-reference content and the disclaimer is visible.

risk_assessment.risk: Final user sign-off on branded image selection
risk_assessment.handling: Obtain final confirmation of the eight-image selection before copying assets into public media and implementing the module.

implementation_recommendation.module_scope: Existing Solution page content enhancement only
implementation_recommendation.required_pre_implementation_gate: User confirms the selected eight branded project-reference images and mandatory disclaimer.

conclusion.message: Doorplate and room-display materials are suitable for a project display module on the Hotel Guest Room Control Solution page.
